question.title: Consecutive Logins
question.desc: Find the users who have logged in for at least 3 consecutive days.
question.solution: WITH consecutive_logins AS ( SELECT user_id, login_date, login_date - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY login_date) AS consecutive_group FROM logins ) SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM consecutive_logins GROUP BY user_id, consecutive_group HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT login_date) >= 3;
question.tips: Use window functions to assign a group to each sequence of consecutive dates for each user.
hints: To solve this, think about how to group consecutive dates together for each user.
Use a window function like ROW_NUMBER to assign a unique number to each row within each user's partition, ordered by date.
Then subtract this row number from the date to create a 'group' that will be the same for consecutive dates.
